summary: The diff partially implements the requested requirements. Backend initialization logic and logging were added to main.mo, and migration.mo was created with seeding data. However, the migration only seeds 2 Nakshatras (Ashwini and Bharani) instead of all 27 required by the BuildRequest. The logging implementation is present but limited. No hallucinated features were detected.

missing_requirements.requirement: All 27 Nakshatras are populated with complete data from migration.mo
missing_requirements.reason: The migration.mo file only includes data for 2 Nakshatras (Ashwini and Bharani), not all 27 as required. The logging states '27 Nakshatras loaded' but this is misleading given only 2 are defined.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend logs initialization events including storage state checks
missing_requirements.reason: While migration success/failure is logged, there is no explicit logging of the storage state check itself (whether storage was empty or not before migration).

missing_requirements.requirement: All 27 Nakshatras are created with name, description, deity, symbol, ruling planet, pada information, lunarClimate, and karmicLesson fields
missing_requirements.reason: Only 2 Nakshatras are created in migration.mo instead of all 27. While the data structure includes all required fields, the quantity requirement is not met.
